question: A rectangular park is 60 m by 40 m. A semicircular pond of diameter 40 m is inside. What percent of the park's area does the pond occupy?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of pond area to park area = (π × r² / 2) / (L × B)

Required % = [π × 20² / (2 × 60 × 40)] × 100

⇒ [400π / 4800] × 100 = (25π / 3)%

⇒ (25 × 22) / (3 × 7) = 550 / 21 ≈ 26.19%

**∴ The correct answer is 26.19%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the rectangular park (L) = 60 m

Breadth of the rectangular park (B) = 40 m

Diameter of the semicircular pond = 40 m ⇒ Radius (r) = 20 m

**Formula Used:**

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth</p&g
